spanish: Solo fuente y cisterna, reunión de aguas, será puro; y el tocante en su cadáver se impurecerá.

findings.issue: The carcass noun is singular, but its suffix is 3rd masculine plural (their carcass). «su» does not mark a plural possessor and, beside the singular participle, reads as the toucher’s own carcass.

notes: The rest of the clause matches the tokens in number, person, and stem.
